074b8c6e13.q: Why is the Launch and Prosper podcast ending and being rebranded to Be Their Human?
074b8c6e13.a: The hosts explain that technology has become much easier for people to launch ideas into the world, so the focus on launching and prospering through technical frameworks like funnels is no longer the primary barrier. Instead, they are shifting toward emphasizing the human component—accountability, mindset coaching, and guidance—which is becoming even more valuable as technical limitations disappear. The new Be Their Human movement reflects this shift toward being a trusted human presence managing digital systems and providing oversight rather than just teaching technical skills.
074b8c6e13.e: The End of an Era: Welcome to Be Their Human
074b8c6e13.rq: Just because technology is advancing and somebody can be flying doesn't necessarily mean they don't need that human component even more.

528c1ac944.q: What is the Be Their Human concept and how does it apply to agency owners?
528c1ac944.a: Be Their Human means being an experienced professional who provides human oversight, accountability, and trust management for clients using AI systems and digital employees. As one host explains, when clients build things with AI tools like Lovable, they still need someone knowledgeable to review and verify everything is solid before launch. The concept emphasizes that despite automation and AI advancement, a human entity remains responsible for results—whether it's a plumber, coach, or business owner, they need a trusted human who takes responsibility and says 'I got you, I will stay on top of all of that so you don't have to.'

f899ffda4c.q: Should agency owners and service providers expand beyond their traditional niche as AI automates more work?
f899ffda4c.a: The guest advises caution: just because you can do something doesn't mean you should. You remain responsible for results. He added copywriting services two years ago using AI and achieved strong conversion rates, so that worked. However, when he attempted paid advertising services, he 'didn't crush it' and had to sever those client relationships because he wasn't delivering the value needed. The key is finding industries underserving their digital presence (like plumbers or commercial cleaning) rather than competing with marketers already skilled in these areas.

f3b33be2b2.q: How does AI changing the market affect mid-tier and low-tier service providers in the funnel and marketing space?
f3b33be2b2.a: The guest states that the middle to low tier has significantly reduced as people learn to do things themselves using AI tools. However, high-level delivery with strong networks still works—if you can deliver results for clients who lack the time or interest to learn themselves. A drop in leads and attention from marketers themselves has affected agencies this year. The shift means many will go out of business unless they can support higher volume of clients at the same quality level, or shift toward the 'Be Their Human' oversight model.

608cc05335.q: Why does a human remain responsible for results even when AI agents perform tasks?
608cc05335.a: The hosts explain that a human entity always retains legal and operational responsibility for outcomes, regardless of whether an AI system executes the work. The example given: if a digital robot performs a stock trade incorrectly causing a million-dollar loss, or performs surgery on the wrong body part, you cannot sue or fire the robot—the human authorized or oversaw it remains responsible. This is why the 'Be Their Human' role is essential: someone must take ownership and say 'I am responsible for this result, whether it takes two minutes or twenty-four hours.'
